Look, just because it has Durosian marble columns out front and an indoor Toorgash range with real grass and live Toorgas doesn't make it any less a jail.|Warlan Presvere Tosk|<ref name="idio">''{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20050825idiosyncracies|text=Idiosyncrasies|int=Idiosyncrasies}}''</ref>}}
A '''Toorga''' was a type of creature that could be kept inside a [[Toorgash range]]. A [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant holding facility|holding facility]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had a Toorgash range with live Toorgas located inside it.
